skill.displayName: AI Hot Girl Image Generator – Create Realistic AI Beauty Images Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI hot girl image — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-hot-girl-image-openapi-skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a skill to transform a portrait or full-body photo into a bikini model image or TikTok-style video.
- Requires a WeShop OpenAPI key and secure HTTPS connection.
- Provides endpoints to start a job, poll status, and upload images.
- Supports customizing output type (image or video), scene description, and batch count (1-16).
- Includes clear API key security instructions and usage guidelines.
